title: A marked run wait can end on a stale state file while a resend of its record is in flight
outcome: While the producer resends a record whose latest pending reason the host keeps in memory, a marked run wait does not fall back to an older wait-ending state file beside the run: the in-memory reason (or an in-flight marker) stays until the send step records the new outcome, and the run's own files no longer making a record still end the wait.
acceptance: A marked run wait can end on a stale state file while a resend of its record is in flight is done
disposal_reason: Per Termal::Fable2 (#6075): the evaluation of w-56f3 on b32c2858 (2c014f1a) failed criterion 1 on exactly this window, because the evaluator reads "the host's look" as the current look. It is fixed inside w-56f3 by candidate 34, a1049152f65d61b4d2e5abdcb9af06d8f411b5a0. The in-memory look is now Pending(reason) or NoBlocker, written on every producer outcome, and a run wait decides from it, never from the state file.
